topicName: Thể cầu khiến: have/get sth done

rules.rule: Cấu trúc cầu khiến bị động (Passive Causative):
rules.formula: S + have / get + Something (Vật) + V(pp) / V3 (+ by Someone)
rules.examples: I had my car repaired yesterday. / She gets her hair cut every month. / We will have the roof fixed before the rainy season.

rules.rule: Cấu trúc cầu khiến chủ động với HAVE (Active Causative with HAVE):
rules.examples: I had the mechanic repair my car. / The teacher had the students write an essay.

rules.rule: Cấu trúc cầu khiến chủ động với GET (Active Causative with GET):
rules.formula: S + get + Someone (Người) + TO V(inf) + Something
rules.examples: I got the plumber to fix the leak. / She got her brother to carry the heavy luggage.

rules.rule: Chuyển đổi câu viết lại (Sentence Transformation):
rules.formula: Someone did something for S -> S had/got something done // S asked/hired someone to do something -> S had someone do / got someone to do something
rules.examples: The painter painted our house. -> We had our house painted by the painter.

rules.rule: Lưu ý quan trọng trong đề thi:
rules.formula: HAVE + người + V nguyên thể (KHÔNG có to) // GET + người + TO V // CẢ HAI: HAVE/GET + vật + V(pp/V3)
rules.examples: He had the technician check (not to check) the computer. / He got the technician to check the computer.
